system.description: You can merge with your vassal, sharing path talents, aspects, and incoming harm. You can choose to use the power pool or your own stats, and when your anchors break, take +1d on the story roll.

notes.description: This can open up a lot of character concepts. You could be a werewolf, have the ghost of a family member possessing you, or know the alchemical secret to turn yourself into a mutated monster!
